_comment: Registry of REAL people's wallet addresses that Ali has personally seen publicly posted (by the person themselves, or a trusted screenshot/clip) -- e.g. a known influencer/creator/trader posting 'here is my wallet'. layer20_notable_wallet_watch.py cross-references every new coin's largest holders against this list: if a big chunk of a brand-new coin's supply lands in one of these wallets, it creates a strong (but UNVERIFIED) impression that the named person launched/endorsed it -- the pattern Ali flagged 21 Oct 2026 after the $Kimchi memecoin (riding trader @kimchi1x's fame after his reported $40M TRUMP trade) hit ~$38.7-40M mcap within about an hour. Add/confirm an entry the moment you see someone post their wallet or verify a match; this grows the registry Ali-side the way bot_wallets.txt grows.
_format: wallet address -> {name, chain, source, added_ts, confirmed: true/false}. confirmed=false still fires alerts (so it gets watched) but is labeled UNVERIFIED in the alert text until checked on-chain.
